title: Writing / Brand Narrative / Sample messaging
slide_intent: Vary message length while preserving the central promise so the audience recognizes the brand in both brief and detailed contexts.
strategic_value: A ladder from tagline to press paragraph can help Duolingo maintain its access-and-possibility story across channels.
demonstration: The panel lists a tagline, short CTAs, one-sentence forms, longer descriptions and a press paragraph in increasing detail.
practical_value: Select a message length for the placement and update historical facts before reuse.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Sample Messaging heading and clarity rationale at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack labeled copy formats at right; keep the long press description last so the progression from compact to detailed remains visible.

reference_purposes.Intent: The left note links short, clear words to transparency with learners.
reference_purposes.Expression: The copy repeatedly frames language learning as accessible and life-expanding.
reference_purposes.Application: The page supplies ready examples for taglines, CTAs, descriptions and press copy.
